_note: Floor two of the Silt Stair. An empty room with a kitchen chair in it facing a door, and the chair is the lock. **`repeats` is on this event**, because three moves in an order is three answers to one object and every other event in this game is a decision that is spent the moment it is made. **No `outside` and `no_homeward`**: the budget here is what you brought, so a save taken on a floor reopens on it — and the gear cannot post you out of a stair under a lake, which is the lake's own reason one map further down. **Floored with `road`, like every other dungeon in this game.** The first draft floored all eight of these with `scrub` — 140 per mille against a pool this strong is a fight every four steps, and `make play` wore a level-twenty board to the sixty percent cap crossing one room and went home. The Cave, the Stack and the map under the lake are all cut passages floored with road at 30, and a floor whose walk costs more than its puzzle is a floor that is a corridor with a toll on it.

places.name: a row of something, in the dark
prose: Nine feet of silt with a row cut into it, and something is coming up out of the row. There is no light down here and there has not been for a long time.
The person kneeling at the end of it says the trick is that the season is not a thing that happens to you. They say it without looking up.
They sell nothing. What a grower has that nobody else does is what comes up between two rows, and it is not for sale.
